note: Seed Reel content for InHouse Wellness. Derived from posts with measured positive engagement in the Mar 2025 - Aug 2026 Buffer history. Consumed by the caption/script generation step. Titles are the frame-zero on-screen text and must work silently.

sets.name: The stress response
sets.evidence_source: Facebook, 300 reach / 156 clicks - highest-click post on record

reels.title: You and a polar bear have the exact same stress response system.
beats: Claim, full frame
Same cortisol, same adrenaline, same ancient wiring - built for a threat lasting minutes
Yours now fires at email, traffic, a bad meeting, and never switches off
Heat and cold trigger that system deliberately, briefly, then let it close
The distinction: a stress response that resolves vs one that doesn't

reels.title: Your body can't tell the difference between a deadline and a predator.
beats: Same physiology, different trigger
The response evolved to end - run, escape, recover
Chronic activation is the new part, and the part research is concerned about
Deliberate short stressors studied as a way to practise recovery
Hedge explicitly: promising, early, not a treatment

reels.title: Cold water doesn't calm you down. That's the point.
reels.required_disclaimer: Cold immersion carries real cardiac risk. One frame, plainly worded.
beats: Everyone calls it relaxing; it isn't, it's an acute stressor
The calm arrives afterward, in the recovery
That gap is the whole mechanism
If it felt relaxing while you were in it, it probably wasn't cold enough

sets.name: Cardiovascular load
sets.evidence_source: Facebook, 176 reach / 23 reactions - highest-reaction post on record
sets.compliance_notes: No claim that sauna treats or prevents cardiovascular disease. Frame as observed physiological response only. Add a line advising anyone on blood-pressure medication to check with a doctor. Do not build until the health-claim validator is live.

reels.title: Your heart rate can climb while you're doing absolutely nothing.
beats: Claim, full frame
No steps, no movement, sitting still on a bench
Actual reading from the Golden Designs unit - heart rate on screen, timer running
The body is working to shed heat, and that work is measurable
We published the number

reels.title: 100 BPM. Zero steps.
beats: Watch face or monitor
Session timer running
Resting baseline shown for contrast
Minimal narration - footage carries it

reels.title: Sauna is not a workout. Here's what the research actually says.
beats: You've seen the 'sauna equals cardio' claim
What studies observed - cardiovascular load during heat exposure, largely Finnish cohort data
What they did NOT show - that it substitutes for exercise, or burns meaningful calories
Close with the evidence-strength badge

sets.name: Same temperature, different heat
sets.evidence_source: 113 IG reach / 206 FB impressions - best explainer on record

reels.title: Same 180°F. Completely different heat.
beats: Claim, full frame
Two cabins, same thermostat reading, entirely different experience
One heats the air around you, one heats you directly
The number on the spec sheet doesn't tell you how it feels
The measurement people compare is the one that matters least

reels.title: The thermostat is lying to you. Sort of.
beats: Three readings from the same session - thermostat, bench height, floor
Show the gap
Heat stratifies, so where you sit changes temperature by a wide margin
Worth knowing before you buy a tall cabin with a low bench

reels.title: Why an infrared sauna at 130°F can feel hotter than steam at 180°F.
beats: Radiant vs convective heat transfer
Sweat onset timing - 8-12 min vs 3-5 min
What each feels like on skin
Animation carries this better than footage

reels.title: A $10,000 sauna can be worse than a $5,000 one.
beats: Claim, full frame
What buyers compare - max temperature, panel count, how the wood looks
What actually decides satisfaction - heater type and wattage, wood species and thickness, warranty length
And who honours that warranty in year three
Price is not a proxy for any of it

reels.title: Near-zero EMF is not a reason to buy a sauna.
beats: It's on every listing
Almost nobody publishes the test - at what distance, which position, by whom
A claim without a measurement is marketing
Transparency is the actual spec

reels.title: The three questions that decide whether you regret this purchase.
beats: Can your electrical panel handle it
Does the ceiling clear it
Who services it in year three
Close to the fit checker
